title: Bridging Human and Model Perspectives: A Comparative Analysis of Political Bias Detection in News Media Using Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating fine-tuned and zero-shot/few-shot large language models on a human-annotated corpus of news articles related to the Israel-Palestine conflict, measuring their ability to classify texts into specific directional bias categories (e.g., 'Biased Against Israel', 'Biased Against Palestine', 'Biased Against Both', 'Biased Against Others') and comparing model predictions against human judgments using agreement metrics like Cohen's Kappa.
